How the Arkansas Paycheck Calculator Works
Federal withholding follows the 2026 percentage method. FICA applies to taxable wages with the entered year-to-date amount used for wage thresholds.
The Arkansas portion multiplies annualized taxable wages after an optional entered state deduction by 3.9%, then divides by pay periods.
Estimated net pay = gross − deductions − 2026 federal withholding − FICA − simplified Arkansas withholding
At $2,000 biweekly taxable pay with no additional state deduction, the simplified Arkansas component is $52,000 × 3.9% ÷ 26 = $78.00 per paycheck. Official wage tables may differ.
